_comment: Market-data providers AfriEdge has an adapter for (packages/market_data/adapters), in the default order they are asked for prices. MARKET_DATA_PRIORITY (environment) overrides the order, e.g. "mansa,dse_public". A provider needing a key is NOT_CONFIGURED until its key is set in the host's dashboard; one whose terms for public display are unresolved is LICENSE_REVIEW_REQUIRED and is never used. Evaluation: docs/PROVIDER_EVALUATION.md.
_reconcile_note: Two providers' closes for the same day that differ by more than 0.5% are CONFLICTING_SOURCE. DSE prices are quoted in whole shillings, so 0.5% is several ticks on any listed share.

providers.name: Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange (public website)
providers.note: The exchange's own published end-of-day prices. Owner decision of 2026-09-19 to use them; public display is switched by DSE_PUBLIC_DISPLAY (Data Vending Policy v1.2, cl. 23.1).

providers.name: Mansa API
providers.note: Professional $50/month, 10,000 requests/day, about 30-minute updates in market hours. Display inside our own site is allowed on every tier, but caching is limited to 7 days and a stored copy counts as redistribution; AfriEdge stores history permanently, so written terms are needed. Adapter UNTESTED (no key).

providers.name: EODHD
providers.note: Covers DSE (NMB.DSE) and USE, not NSE Kenya. Personal plans forbid display; the internal-use plan forbids showing data outside the company; public display needs Enterprise (2,499/month) or Custom by agreement. Adapter UNTESTED (no key).
